title: United becomes the first US airline to close its booking flow to AI agents
summary: United's website terms, updated on 11 November, now require written permission before any automated agent searches, books, buys or manages a trip on united.com or in its app, and bar the use of its fares and availability data to train or ground a model. Search-engine indexing stays exempt, and bookings agents made before that date are being honoured. United cites credential sharing, unintended purchases and check-in rules that require a human to confirm what is in the bags.
